fullPassage: Literary study, like all disciplines, has developed its own terminology and its own techniques. Some knowledge and understanding of both can greatly enhance our personal appreciation of literature and our conversations with others about it. Literature also has a context and a history, and learning something about them can make all the difference in the amount and kind of pleasure and insight you derive from literature. By reading and discussing different genres of literature, as well as works from varied times and places, you may well come to appreciate and even love works that you might never have discovered or chosen to read on your own or that you might have disliked or misunderstood if you had read them alone. Most important, writing about works of literature and discussing them with teachers and other students will give you practice in analyzing literature in greater depth and in considering alternative views of both the works themselves and the situations and problems the works explore. A clear understanding of the aims and designs of a story, poem, or play never falls like a bolt from the blue. Instead, it emerges from a process that involves trying to put into words how and why this work had such an effect on you and, just as important, responding to what others say or write about it. Literature itself is a vast, ongoing, ever-evolving conversation in which we most fully participate when we enter into actual conversation with others.

questions.passage:
(A) A clear understanding of the aims and <u>designs</u> of a story or poem does not come easily.

(B) The architect <u>designs</u> beautiful buildings for the city center.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 designs의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① 무늬 — 설계하다 (A는 '무늬'가 아닌 '의도·구상')
❌ ② 설계하다 — 의도 (의미 뒤바뀜)
❌ ③ 의도 — 그리다 (B는 '그리다'가 아닌 '설계하다')
✅ ④ 의도 — 설계하다 ←정답
det.tip: designs: (A) 명사 — 의도, 구상 vs (B) 동사 — 설계하다

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어는?

"a particular style or category of literature, art, or music"

det.analysis:
❌ ① context — 맥락 (범주가 아님)
❌ ② terminology — 전문 용어 (범주가 아님)
✅ ③ genre — 장르, 갈래 ←정답
❌ ④ technique — 기법 (범주가 아님)
det.tip: genre = 장르, 갈래 (문학·예술의 양식적 범주)

questions.passage: By reading and discussing different genres of literature, you may well come to appreciate and even love works that you might never have __________ (discover) or chosen to read on your own.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 결코 발견하지 못했을 → 현재완료 have + 과거분사 → discovered
det.analysis: might never have __________ → 조동사 + have + 과거분사 자리 = 완료형 → discovered
det.tip: discover(발견하다) → discovered(과거분사): have discovered = 발견해 왔다/발견하다

questions.passage: Writing about works of literature and discussing them with teachers and other students will give you practice in __________ (analyze) literature in greater depth.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 문학을 분석하는 연습 → 전치사 in 다음 동명사 → analyzing
det.analysis: practice in __________ literature → 전치사 in + 동명사 자리 → analyzing
det.tip: analyze(분석하다) → analyzing(동명사): practice in analyzing = 분석하는 연습

questions.passage: Literary study, like all disciplines, has developed its own terminology and its own techniques. Some knowledge and understanding of both can greatly enhance our personal appreciation of literature and our conversations with others about it. Literature also has a context and a history, and learning something about them can make all the difference in the amount and kind of pleasure and insight you derive from literature. By reading and discussing different genres of literature, as well as works from varied times and places, you may well come to appreciate and even love works that you might never have discovered or chosen to read on your own or that you might have disliked or misunderstood if you had read them alone. Most important, writing about works of literature and discussing them __________ will give you practice in analyzing literature in greater depth and in considering alternative views of both the works themselves and the situations and problems the works explore. A clear understanding of the aims and designs of a story, poem, or play never falls like a bolt from the blue. Instead, it emerges from a process that involves trying to put into words how and why this work had such an effect on you and, just as important, responding to what others say or write about it. Literature itself is a vast, ongoing, ever-evolving conversation in which we most fully participate when we enter into actual conversation with others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 작품에 관해 쓰고 '교사 및 다른 학생들과' 토론하는 것이 분석 연습을 준다는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① with teachers and other students — 교사·다른 학생들과 ←정답
❌ ② without any outside help — 외부 도움 없이 (타인과의 대화 강조와 모순)
❌ ③ in complete silence alone — 완전히 홀로 침묵 속에 (글의 협력 주제와 모순)
❌ ④ before reading them fully — 충분히 읽기 전에 (문맥 무관)
det.tip: 글 전체 주제 = 타인과의 대화·토론이 문학 이해를 깊게 한다

Some knowledge and understanding of both can greatly enhance our personal appreciation of literature and our conversations with others about it. By reading and discussing different genres of literature, as well as works from varied times and places, you may well come to appreciate and even love works that you might never have discovered or chosen to read on your own or that you might have disliked or misunderstood if you had read them alone. Most important, writing about works of literature and discussing them with teachers and other students will give you practice in analyzing literature in greater depth and in considering alternative views of both the works themselves and the situations and problems the works explore. A clear understanding of the aims and designs of a story, poem, or play never falls like a bolt from the blue. Instead, it emerges from a process that involves trying to put into words how and why this work had such an effect on you and, just as important, __________. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이해는 자신의 반응을 언어로 표현하고, 그만큼 중요하게 '타인의 말·글에 반응하는' 과정에서 나온다는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① ignoring the opinions of other readers — 다른 독자 의견 무시 (타인과의 대화 강조와 모순)
✅ ② responding to what others say or write about it — 타인의 말·글에 반응하기 ←정답
❌ ③ memorizing the plot of every story — 줄거리 암기 (글의 논지와 무관)
❌ ④ avoiding all discussion with classmates — 토론 회피 (주제와 모순)
det.tip: just as important 뒤 = 타인의 말·글에 반응하기(responding to what others say or write)
